tentative_claims.text: The mechanism I propose is a harm-volume-indexed liability framework, implemented by a multi-stakeholder body under the authority of the National Institute of Standards and Technology, which decouples safety obligations from capital expenditure to prevent market monopolization.
By mandating that all foundational models undergo externalized reasoning monitoring, regulators can force systems to expose their internal logic for inspection.
A tiered-liability framework ensures that the party creating the risk is held accountable for the specific harm-volume they unleash.
